short_description:
Where to find alligators in GTA 6: Grassrivers, the swamp region in southern Leonida. Check open water and the grassy shores, take an airboat to cross the swamp fast, and watch the pools in town: Rockstar showed animal control pulling a gator out of one. Guides haven't published exact spawn points yet. Sources: Rockstar Games, GTABase, games.gg, Red Bull, Xbox Play, EGamers.

📍 Map Spot #17 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

facts_note: Nov 26 (YouTube search 'gta 6 alligator', 56 views to our LACY clip, no Short of ours answers it). Grassrivers = the alligator region (Rockstar, GTABase, games.gg, Red Bull, Xbox Play); open water + vegetated shores (GTABase, Xbox Play); airboats are Grassrivers' vehicle (Rockstar, Red Bull); a gator in a residential pool is in Rockstar's first trailer (Xbox Play, EGamers). Left out: albino alligators (no source confirms) and exact spawn points (guides say none are published yet).
